limitations: Originality is to the best of current knowledge. The result refutes only the literal same-form q-ary extension. A same-day published record gives the smallest \([5,2,2]_q\) counterexample, while the all-\(d\) family and unbounded gap are the audited contribution. A later record gives a sharp dimension-two classification but postdates this result. Older code catalogues may contain equivalent elementary codes without this interpretation.
record_title: Nonbinary counterexamples to the literal mirror-vanishing extension
